page.layout: One column of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, with the running head and page number at the top right. The left edge is cut, so several lines begin with fragments. A catchword stands at the lower right.

main_text.p: exusu Chaldaico. Quandoq, est cum ש.
ספר סַפֵּר Pihel ספר Numerare, Annumerare, Recensere, Narrare. Niphal נִסְפַּר.
סֹפֵר m. Scriba, Cancellarius, Legisperitus: plur. סֹפְרִים.
סְפָרָא, סִפְרָא m. Chald. idem, Esr. 4. & 7.
סֵפֶר m. Enumeratio, Recensio: Liber, Libellus, Epistola, Litera, quod in eis res varia Enarrentur & Recensentur: plur. סְפָרִים.
סִפְרָא, ספרא m. Chal. idem: סֵפֶר משה Libri Mosis, Esr. 6.18: בִּסְפַר דָּכְרַנְיָא In libro memoriarum, Esr. 4.15: plur. סִפְרִין & סִפְרַיָּא.
סַפִּיר m. Sapphirus gemma: plur. סַפִּירִים.
אִסְפְּרָא Chal. Citò, Celeriter, Festinanter, quasi Numero dicas.
סָקַל Lapidare. Niphal נִסְקַל Lapidari Pihel סַקֵּל Lapidare, & contraria significatione, Elapidare, Lapides amovere, à lapidibus purgare. Pyhal סֻקַּל. Lapidari.

page.notes: The left edge is cut away, so the first letters of several lines are missing or fragmentary. Hebrew vowel points are read with uncertainty, especially in the forms marked [?]. The running head is Hebrew and only partly legible. The catchword at the lower right is read as סרב.
